jobs.title: 2nd Engineer
jobs.summary: Shipboard engineering position overseeing machinery during engine-room watches and supporting safe technical operations.
responsibilities: Monitor propulsion and auxiliary equipment during assigned watches.
Maintain engineering records and support planned maintenance.
requirements: IMO Regulation III/2 second-engineer certification and relevant STCW certificates.
High-school qualification and the employer's stated age eligibility.
Confirm experience eligibility with Carnival: the detailed requirements specify three or more watchkeeping years, while the summary panel specifies five years in similar roles.

jobs.title: 2nd ETO
jobs.summary: Electro-technical position maintaining shipboard electrical equipment, automation and communication systems.
responsibilities: Perform planned electrical maintenance and fault repairs.
Support safe operation of navigation, power and control equipment.
requirements: STCW III/6 competency certificate and required basic training.
The detailed listing specifies 24–36 months of cruise-ship electro-technical officer experience.
English proficiency and the employer's stated age eligibility.
preferred_qualifications: Relevant electro-technical degree and experience at the same or a more senior shipboard level.

jobs.title: Public Health Officer
jobs.summary: Shipboard public-health position supporting sanitation, infection prevention, inspections and crew training.
responsibilities: Audit public-health practices and communicate corrective actions.
Support disease prevention, water safety and pest-management programmes.
requirements: Relevant public-health, environmental-health, medical or related scientific background.
Two years of shipboard or three years of full-time shoreside public-health programme experience.
At least 21 years old; consult the source for all qualification requirements.
preferred_qualifications: Cruise-industry experience and relevant sanitation or infection-control certifications.

jobs.title: Commis Team Dining
jobs.summary: Crew-galley cooking role preparing meals for shipboard team members and supporting food-quality and sanitation standards.
responsibilities: Prepare crew meals under the staff chef's direction.
Support stock checks, kitchen hygiene and efficient meal service.
requirements: Conversational English and foundational culinary skills.
At least one year in a four-star-or-higher hotel or restaurant kitchen serving continental food.
preferred_qualifications: Hospitality or food-production qualification; the employer identifies this as preferred, not mandatory.
